b.answer:
Worked example: a 60-row invented contact sheet for a fictional pharmacy in Ibadan.

source        | column    | → property              | transform
clients.xlsx  | Name      | firstname / lastname    | split on first space; proper case
clients.xlsx  | Tel       | phone                   | text; strip spaces; 0… → +234…
clients.xlsx  | Email     | email                   | trim; lowercase; blank if no @
clients.xlsx  | Branch    | ph_branch (dropdown)    | 'bodija','Bodija ' → Bodija

Formulas: =LOWER(TRIM(C2)) for email; =IF(LEFT(B2,1)="0","+234"&MID(B2,2,20),B2) for phone (after removing spaces). Rejects tab: 4 rows (no phone and no email: 3; impossible date of last visit: 1), each with a reason.
mistakes: Phones stored as numbers, losing the leading 0.
Rows silently dropped instead of listed in rejects.
Dropdown values with spelling variants left in.
b.pass: A mapping sheet covering every source column (mapped or dropped with a reason) and a clean staging tab where every row is valid or in rejects with a reason.
b.redo: Send it back if any row disappears without a reason, phones aren't normalised, or dropdown values don't match the allowed list.

s.answer:
Worked example: n8n workflow "Migrate · Clean and load" against a HubSpot trial.

Manual Trigger → Google Sheets (read staging)
→ Code: normalise + validate → IF valid
   ✗ → Sheets 'rejects' (row, reason)
   ✓ → Code: group by email, then phone (strong keys)
      → HubSpot: search contact by ph_legacy_id
      → IF found → update : create (ph_legacy_id unique)
→ Code: count per object → Sheets 'reconciliation'

Run 1: 512 created, 0 updated, 37 rejects. Run 2 (same file): 0 created, 512 updated (unchanged values), reconciliation diff 0.

Name-only matches (14) written to a 'review' tab, not merged.
mistakes: No unique external ID, so run 2 creates duplicates.
No retry or wait on rate-limit errors.
Reconciliation done by eye rather than counts.
s.pass: A workflow that cleans, validates, de-duplicates on strong keys and loads with a unique external ID; a second run creates nothing new; a reconciliation table with zero differences.
s.redo: Send it back if the second run creates records, merges happen on names, or there is no reconciliation.

g.answer:
Worked example of evidence (client anonymised): "Client B, 3-branch clinic, 9,800 rows across 5 sheets".

Load 1 (20 per object) ... 2 mapping fixes
Load 2 (10%) .............. 0 diffs
Cutover: freeze Fri 17:00 · delta Fri 18:00 · reconcile Sat 10:00
Go / no-go Sat 14:00: GO (signed by practice manager)
Final: 3,104 contacts · 0 diffs · 0 without owner
Rollback trigger: any diff > 0 or permission test fail

Hypercare notes: 7 "can't find" reports in two weeks; 5 were search habits (trained), 2 were rejects the clinic later fixed and loaded.
mistakes: Hypercare without a log of issues and fixes.
g.pass: A real migration with test loads, a frozen cutover, a delta load, a reconciliation log with zero differences, a written go/no-go and two weeks of hypercare notes, all anonymised.
g.redo: Send it back if reconciliation shows unexplained differences, there's no rollback plan, or personal data isn't removed.
